name: Auto-suggest target region competitors without URLs
expected_behavior: Checks .agents/<productname>/product.md for product context
Recognizes product is our product target region
Auto-suggests local competitors: Free Online Study Notes, Kahoot, Competitor Notes Hub, YouTube channels, physical tuition centers
Asks for permission before researching
Requests depth level and focus areas

name: Deep competitor profile with URLs
prompt: Deep competitor profile for merospark.com and studynotes.example.com
expected_behavior: Creates structured profiles for both competitors
Includes positioning, pricing, features, content strategy, and weaknesses
Saves raw data and profiles in competitor-profiles/ directory
Creates cross-competitor summary with side-by-side comparison table
Identifies gaps EduPlatform can exploit

name: Competitive comparison focused on pricing
prompt: Compare our pricing vs Free Online Study Notes and YouTube channels for local exam preparation
expected_behavior: Identifies EduPlatform's paid model vs free alternatives
Analyzes value proposition justifying EduPlatform's price premium
Highlights features free alternatives lack (testpapers, diagnostic reports, dialogic videos)
Suggests positioning strategies to compete against free
Follows chatty iterative approach

name: Quick scan of a single competitor
expected_behavior: Performs a quick scan (not deep profile)
Covers positioning, features, and key signals
Avoids unverified claims
Completes in a single interaction with minimal follow-up

name: Find market gaps in target region EdTech
prompt: Find gaps in the target region EdTech market that we can exploit
expected_behavior: Scans multiple competitors across the landscape
Identifies unserved or underserved segments
Highlights EduPlatform's unique capabilities vs market gaps
Provides actionable recommendations
References target region-specific factors (Curriculum Board syllabus, exam calendar, payment methods)
